context.transcript:
Before we end our meeting today, I have two updates that will affect our library.
First, the parking area is being resurfaced on Sunday.
Although we'll be closed, we'll post signs letting patrons know they can access the book return box by using the walkway on the east side of the building.
Also, we met our fundraising goal to modernize our building's technology systems.
I can't list all the benefits, but new computers will start arriving Monday.
More exciting updates will follow.
context.transcript_translation:
在我们结束今天的会议之前，我有两个会影响我们图书馆的更新。
首先，停车区域将在周日重新铺设路面。
虽然我们将关闭，但我们会张贴告示让顾客知道，他们可以通过建筑东侧的人行道使用图书归还箱。
此外，我们达到了现代化本馆技术系统的筹款目标。
我不能列出所有好处，但新电脑将于周一开始到货。
更多令人兴奋的更新即将到来。
